750df3cd793c86ebbf125da70e1010e42d96b397.summary: This is a GitHub repository README for the SentinelLabs SUNBURST Assessment Tool. The tool checks a Windows machine's running processes, services and drivers against the blacklist that the SUNBURST malware uses, and reports whether SUNBURST would exit. It describes the tool's version hashes and shows example output from a monitored system and a malware analyst's machine. It is a description of a defensive utility, not a report on threat activity.

753f6e8856abbb4ddb5b93a3aa409979f93f8ff5.summary: Microsoft Security Research reports threat actors abusing GSocket, an open-source remote access tool, on compromised Linux servers, mostly web applications and hosting. GSocket relays traffic through a shared public network, so there is no actor-owned IP address to block, and it keeps access after the original web vulnerability is patched. Telemetry shows GSocket-related detections rising 356.2% from March to August 2026. In a few incidents actors attempted privilege escalation using CVE-2026-43284. Education and research was the most-affected sector at 30.7% of organisations.
